title: Replace Target Digit in a Number

content.problemStatement: Write a program to replace a digit with another digit of the number . Get 3 numbers as input. The first is the number num1 and second is the digit that needs to be replaced. The third is the digit that is to replace the 2nd digit. Print the number after performing this operation
content.inputFormat: Given three  integers separated by space.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Replace all occurrences of character d1 with d2 in string S.
solution.editorial: Iterate through string S, replacing occurrences of d1 with d2.
